printed_metrology.measurement_method: Owner used a physical ruler to confirm the printed 100 mm scale is 100 mm. Printed on A4 at 100%.
printed_metrology.note: 30 mm square geometry retained from design. X/Y square lengths and flatness were not independently measured; do not treat them as measured values.

transform_convention: T_target_source maps p_source to p_target; translations in metres
optical_axes: x right, y down, z forward
usd_camera_axes: x right, y up, z backward; R_optical_usd = diag(1,-1,-1)
rendering_notes: Preserve full K, including off-centre principal point and unequal fx/fy.
Use native depth optical Z, not Euclidean range or RGB-aligned depth.
Renderer depth in metres is not raw Z16; use depth_scale only for raw sensor integers.
Independent IR fits must not silently replace the K of device-rectified depth.
Hardware depth noise, holes, minimum usable distance and exposure response are not calibrated by this bundle.
